purpose: Teach: くれれ/ならば/混入/マッチング/尚/４つ/小銭/おこっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんに電話くれれば、いつでも遊ぼう
lines.en: Sho, call me anytime you want to play, okay? Mei-sis is always here for you.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone with a soft smile in the voice. Opening with his name gently. Patient rhythm, the kind of reassurance that makes a child feel safe and wanted. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、雨ならば、お家で遊ぼうね
lines.en: Mei-sis, if it rains, let's play at home together.
lines.style: Quiet and thoughtful. A small child working through the idea carefully, not rushing. Gentle acceptance in his voice. Soft landing on the suggestion, like he's offering her a choice that feels safe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お料理に異物の混入のないように作ろうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure nothing gets mixed into the food when we cook, okay?
lines.style: Clear, practical instruction spoken with warmth underneath. Patient teacher's tone—not lecturing, guiding. Light emphasis on 'nothing' to make the rule stick. Calm, attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくとお父さんの色のマッチング、見て
lines.style: Bright with quiet pride. The opening 'look' is eager, wanting her attention before he shows her. Small boy's genuine pleasure, unperformed. A moment of shine in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、尚、お母さんが、お土産持って来てくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, and—oh! Mom brought back a souvenir for you.
lines.style: Gentle pivot into good news. Warm tone, the kind of kindness that's about giving him something to look forward to. Slight lift on the revelation, but unhurried. Thoughtful timing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのおもちゃ、４つになっちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I have four toys now!
lines.style: Bubbling excitement just barely contained. The number comes out with wonder—counting up feels important to him. Quick, alive delivery. A child sharing something he's been thinking about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お小銭、お母さんの財布に入れておいてね
lines.en: Sho, put the coins back in Mom's wallet for me, would you?
lines.style: Gentle request phrased as a task he can do. Trusting his help, not demanding. Light, easy tone—the kind of instruction a child remembers because it made him feel useful. Warm closing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの遠足で、面白いことおこったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, something really funny happened on my field trip!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy right from the start. Can't quite wait to tell her—the words tumble out with anticipation. Open, animated, a kid who knows she'll actually listen. Warm rush of a story about to come.
